snippet.title: FUTURE REALITY - TRAILER EEK3 2022
snippet.description:
Get ready to race high speed jets fueled by bio refuse in a dark future🚀🏁

Future Reality is a ʀᴀᴄɪɴɢ - ʜᴏʀʀᴏʀ game with retro styled visuals aiming to combine the 90s racing games' vibes with a brand new take on the racing genre.

- Often quoted "It's how you remember Wipeout being but better."

Follow the game's development: https://twitter.com/FutureRealityRL
